dev.everyos.calculator.rationale: Store calculation history and copy explicitly selected results.

dev.everyos.calendar.rationale: Store events, import or export chosen calendars and send reminders through the upcoming-events widget.

dev.everyos.code.rationale: Store editor state and edit only explicitly chosen workspace folders or files.

dev.everyos.color.rationale: Store palettes, copy color values and export generated palette files.

dev.everyos.cron.rationale: Store scheduling drafts and copy or export the generated expression.

dev.everyos.diff.rationale: Store comparison preferences, compare chosen files, copy differences and export patches.

dev.everyos.disk.rationale: Measure only chosen folders plus permitted host storage and metrics, retain scope and export measurements.

dev.everyos.dns.rationale: Query explicitly approved outbound DNS resolvers, retain history and copy actual responses.

dev.everyos.gallery.rationale: Index only chosen image files or folders and retain album references; source files cannot be written or deleted.

dev.everyos.httpmonitor.rationale: Monitor explicitly approved HTTP endpoints, retain history, export observations and notify failures.

dev.everyos.images.rationale: Read only chosen images, retain selected references and export unchanged originals through the save picker.

dev.everyos.json.rationale: Store editor preferences, inspect chosen JSON files, export formatted data and copy results.

dev.everyos.jwt.rationale: Store decoder preferences and copy or export inspected token fields; no server credentials are read.

dev.everyos.logs.rationale: Read permitted host journal records, retain filters and export the selected log snapshot.

dev.everyos.markdown.rationale: Store drafts, edit chosen Markdown files, export documents and copy rendered text.

dev.everyos.network.rationale: Read permitted host interfaces and metrics, probe approved endpoints and export diagnostic snapshots.

dev.everyos.notes.rationale: Store notes, open or export chosen files, copy text and provide a scoped quick-note widget.

dev.everyos.pdf.rationale: Remember reading positions and open, save or print only chosen PDF documents.

dev.everyos.pomodoro.rationale: Store timer preferences, send completion notifications and expose the active timer widget.

dev.everyos.ports.rationale: Read host socket metadata, retain filters and export the current listener snapshot.

dev.everyos.regex.rationale: Store expressions and copy matching or replacement results; matching stays in a worker.

dev.everyos.sql.rationale: Use approved server database connections, retain nonsecret preferences and export selected query results.

dev.everyos.sshkeys.rationale: Manage the user SSH-key vault, export explicitly approved keys and copy public keys only.

dev.everyos.ssl.rationale: Inspect explicitly approved TLS endpoints and retain endpoint history.

dev.everyos.text.rationale: Store editor preferences and open or save only explicitly chosen text files.

dev.everyos.todo.rationale: Store tasks, import or export chosen task files, send reminders and provide the task widget.

dev.everyos.uptime.rationale: Read host uptime, approved endpoint and service health, retain history and notify through the scoped health widget.

dev.everyos.video.rationale: Stream only chosen videos and subtitle sidecars, retaining playlist references and playback settings.

dev.everyos.whiteboard.rationale: Store boards and import or export only chosen drawing files.
